unit.why: Homiletic comments on parashot Tazria, Aharei and Kedoshim: teachings on sanctity in marital relations, humility, guarding speech, anger and rebuke, quoted from the Maggid of Kozienice, the Mogielnica rebbe and other books. The only near-narrative is a one-line exchange in which a man asks a tzaddik to teach him and gets a reply, which is a framed saying rather than a story.
unit.boundary_note: division ends at the heading 'פרשת אמור'; the next division opens a new parasha with a story
